glossary.source_title: Section 2323.43 - Limitation on compensatory damages that represent economic loss.

glossary.definition: (3) "Noneconomic loss" means nonpecuniary harm that results from an injury, death, or loss to person or property that is a subject of a civil action upon a medical, dental, optometric, or chiropractic claim, including, but not limited to, pain and suffering, loss of society, consortium, companionship, care, assistance, attention, protection, advice, guidance, counsel, instruction, training, or education, disfigurement, mental anguish, and any other intangible loss.
glossary.source_title: Section 2323.43 - Limitation on compensatory damages that represent economic loss.

glossary.definition:
(4) "Trier of fact" means the jury or, in a nonjury action, the court.
